scope: Original research candidates, not integrated manuscript figures

figures.caption: History recurrence and attention history have different lifetimes. The recurrent layer group updates bounded state, while a separate full-attention layer group retains growing KV history. Three token positions are schematic. Qwen3.8-27B supplies the configuration-backed example, not a measured memory ratio.
figures.alt_text: Three token-time columns show equal-sized recurrent-state boxes. Each state feeds the next recurrent update through a routed arrow. Below, a separate full-attention history grows from one to two to three KV cells. The recurrent and attention states belong to different layer groups.
figures.quantitative_scope: Mechanism schematic, not to scale; no benchmark curves

figures.caption: Shared-depth execution reuses weights, not necessarily history state. Distinct iteration caches are shown for the separate-cache case. A true exit omits later work; selecting an earlier representation after all passes does not. The exit after pass 2 is illustrative, not an Ouro performance result.
figures.alt_text: One shared-weight rail supplies three core invocations. Each invocation has its own red history-cache slot. Below, an actual-stop lane executes passes 1 and 2 and leaves pass 3 unexecuted. A post-hoc lane executes all three passes before selecting the pass-2 representation.
